title: Authorized Days and Covered Days on TRICARE Select Stays Reprocessed for Other Health Insurance
content:
**Rule.** Where an Inpatient Mental Health Authorization for the patient at the stay's facility starting on the admission date was approved (whether its days are still open or have all been used) for fewer days than the stay billed, the covered days of a reprocessed **TRICARE Select** stay are the days it authorized; where the stay's service class is in the tier's list of service classes needing prior authorization and no such approved authorization is on file, a reprocessed stay has no covered day; otherwise every billed inpatient day of a reprocessed stay is covered.

The authorization is the patient's Inpatient Mental Health Authorization recorded in Referrals and Authorizations - its status (approved, or exhausted once all its days are used), its servicing facility, its start date and the days it authorized. The service class needing prior authorization is the inpatient mental health admission on every TRICARE Select tier: the TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A and Group B tiers, TRICARE Select Retiree Group A and TRICARE Select Retiree Group B.

## Condition - judgement - result

| Authorization at the stay's facility, starting on the admission date | Status | Days authorized against days billed | Stay's service class | Covered days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| on file | approved or exhausted | fewer | any | the days it authorized |
| on file | approved or exhausted | equal or more | any | every billed day |
| none of that kind | - | - | inpatient mental health admission | none |
| none of that kind | - | - | acute inpatient admission | every billed day |

## Hypothetical stays

- Inpatient mental health stay billed for 11 days; an authorization at that facility from the admission date approved for 5 days and since exhausted: 5 covered days.
- The same stay where the authorization was denied: no covered day.
- An acute inpatient admission of 4 days: 4 covered days.
